assertions.name: red_replays_recording
assertions.detail: uses the recording's milk and date

final_message:
I'll look at the recording and the existing tests so the new test fails the same way the household request does.The recording shows milk expiring on the same day as the query is left out. I'll add a test that follows those three requests and expects both milk and yogurt.`test_an_item_that_runs_out_today_is_listed` fails on the recorded household request. Milk that runs out on 2026-10-21 is missing from what runs out within three days of that date.

The test follows the recording in `.xv/recordings/expiring-today.json`:

- Add milk with `expires_on` 2026-10-21.
- Add yogurt with `expires_on` 2026-10-23.
- `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` should return both.

The call returns only yogurt. The other 11 tests pass.
